query:
SELECT c.id, c.code, c.semester, comp.code as component_code
FROM classes c
JOIN components comp ON c.componentId = comp.id
WHERE comp.code = 'TEC502' AND c.semester = '2026.1' AND c.code = 'TP01'
LIMIT 5;
